minimum.label: Find a minimum count
minimum.observed: The footprint and elevation peaks constrain the minimum: jointly realize every peak with the fewest added cubes.
minimum.construct: Choose independent or competing peaks on a supported stack. Vary heights and footprint; make a plausible number by taking independent row and column lower bounds as simultaneously attainable. Solve the printed views jointly and keep height witnesses.

maximum.label: Find a maximum count
maximum.observed: The footprint and elevation peaks constrain the maximum: each occupied column must obey all crossing upper bounds.
maximum.construct: Choose independent or competing peaks on a supported stack. Vary heights and footprint; make a plausible number by ignoring a cap from the other view. Solve the printed views jointly and keep height witnesses.

possible.label: Find a possible count
possible.observed: The footprint and elevation peaks constrain the feasible total: exhibit at least one complete height map.
possible.construct: Choose independent or competing peaks on a supported stack. Vary heights and footprint; make a plausible number by accepting a number merely because it fits one elevation. Solve the printed views jointly and keep height witnesses.

exact.label: Determine the unique total
exact.observed: Two- and three-view originals ask about extrema or attainable totals under floor support.
exact.construct: Construct different totals that share Front and Top. Add a Left elevation that rules out all but one total. Dropping it must restore ambiguity when claiming the third view matters.
exact.extension: Exact-count questions and the paired missing-view diagnostic extend the original question forms.
